purpose: Per-position major evidence across the 专业 and 备注 columns, with explicit code spans, education namespaces and reason classes. Not an eligibility engine.

coverage_before.source: data/majors_2027 manifest summary (专业 column only)

coverage_conservative.basis: exact codes or names in the 专业 and 备注 columns, gate-prefixed exact names, source-declared gate codes, and explicitly unrestricted texts

coverage_provisional_only.status: provisional; not part of the conservative numerator

coverage_inclusive.basis: conservative coverage plus provisional gate-scope positions

coverage_after.basis: inclusive: exact evidence or a gate-scope hit; see coverage_conservative for the numerator that excludes the agency-scope inference

conflicts.origin_note: shared_name_slash_group = name shared by a slash-separated code run; compound_catalog_name_truncation = the catalog name itself contains a separator and the token was cut at it; category_member_enumeration = a category code followed by an enumeration of its members; category_suffix_variant = another code name plus 类; old_name_or_short_name = a prefix/short form of the catalog name; direct_code_name_inconsistency = the remaining cases, which need a human or the recruiting agency to confirm and are NOT asserted to be source errors.
conflicts.family_note: semantic_conflict = the printed name belongs to a different code. multi_namespace_diagnostic = the same code names something else at another education level, or the source omitted a 类 suffix; these are diagnostics, not proof of a source error.
conflicts.note: positions 与 entries 不是同一口径。另有一组门类码与名称错配（gate_code_name_mismatch）只写入 reason_classes，不进入 conflicts 数组，因此不包含在 positions/entries 内。
conflicts.details_sharded_in: position-evidence records with a non-empty conflicts list

review_scope.note: Positions whose requirement text carries at least one review reason. Coverage is a catalog reference, never a full interpretation.

normalization_rules.rule: 专业要求写作“X门类”或“X学科门类”时，按 X 学科门类节点解析；不据此判定个人可报。

basis.title: 关于教育部2027年度公务员考录职位要求的说明
basis.applies_to: 教育部 2027 年度考录职位；其门类/一级学科包含语义为国内通行口径
basis.text: 职位专业要求为学科门类的，即该门类所包含的专业和一级学科均符合要求；专业要求为一级学科的，即该一级学科所包含的二级学科均符合要求。

normalization_rules.rule: 原文自带两位门类代码（如“经济学类（02）”）时，按该门类节点解析。

reason_taxonomy.major_text_unrestricted: 专业 column is exactly 不限/无限制/专业不限/不限专业
reason_taxonomy.no_explicit_code_in_major_column: no four-to-seven digit token in 专业
reason_taxonomy.institution_local_code: Z/J/S style code; suffix is assigned by the granting unit
reason_taxonomy.code_outside_education_scope: the code exists in the other education namespace only; levels are not merged and it is not counted as coverage
reason_taxonomy.code_unresolved_in_loaded_catalogs: code form recognized but no catalog node has it
reason_taxonomy.gate_code_name_mismatch: printed two-digit gate code disagrees with the name after it
reason_taxonomy.negative_or_exclusion_present: 专业 text contains an exclusion expression
reason_taxonomy.open_scope_or_qualifier: 专业 text contains 相关/等专业/方向/仅限 style wording
reason_taxonomy.degree_word_inside_single_clause: a degree word sits inside an undivided clause
reason_taxonomy.category_phrase_without_exact_catalog_no: text ends a phrase in 类 with no exact catalog node
reason_taxonomy.no_machine_readable_code_in_major_column: no code recovered from 专业
reason_taxonomy.no_machine_readable_code_in_remarks_colu: no code or exact name recovered from 备注
reason_taxonomy.name_exists_only_in_other_education_leve: a bare name has an exact catalog node only at a different education level, which is not treated as a match
reason_taxonomy.bachelor_category_name_in_graduate_posit: the text uses a bachelor category name in a graduate-only position; the graduate catalog has no node with that name
reason_taxonomy.colloquial_gate_name_with_类_suffix: a discipline-gate name written with a 类 suffix, e.g. 理学类; not an official category and not normalized
reason_taxonomy.agency_category_without_published_member: the agency uses an in-house category phrase such as 经济金融类 or 气象类; no applicable 2027 membership list was found in the public sources checked
reason_taxonomy.agency_category_membership_unverified: the agency uses an in-house category phrase, but whether it publishes a membership list was not verified in this round
reason_taxonomy.code_name_conflict: a printed name next to a code disagrees with the catalog name

field_semantics.备注: position remarks text, original string; telephone numbers, years and area codes are filtered out

cross_field_dedup: A position is counted once per complete code; both field origins are kept.

semantics.catalog_candidate: An exact code or exact catalog name was found in a compatible education namespace. This is not a full interpretation of the requirement and not an applicant eligibility result.
semantics.new_catalogs: The two graduate enrollment code books are the only public documents that enumerate six-digit graduate secondary codes; the 2026 self-set roster publishes names only and confers no code.
semantics.no_fuzzy_matching: Names match only exactly; 会计学类 is not treated as 会计学.
semantics.additivity: A position can carry several codes; code counts never sum to national totals.

residual_strata.method: assigned from the raw 专业 text, not from extracted term labels

summary.review_universe_note: Legacy denominator: requirements carrying at least one review reason in the original three-catalog layer.

conflict_bucket_composition.note: This bucket counts positions inside the review universe only. The library-wide structured conflict set is a different set: it has its own position count (manifest summary conflicts.positions), which must not be substituted here.

bucket_rules.no_candidate_agency_no_public_list: no catalog candidate; no applicable 2027 membership list was found in the public sources checked
bucket_rules.no_candidate_agency_unverified: no catalog candidate; agency uses in-house categories but publication not verified
bucket_rules.no_candidate_other: no catalog candidate; national catalog vocabulary or open scope
bucket_rules.candidate_with_conflict: has candidate; a printed name contradicts the code
bucket_rules.candidate_with_exclusion: has candidate; exclusion or negative condition present
bucket_rules.candidate_with_degree_scope: has candidate; clause/degree scope still ambiguous
bucket_rules.candidate_with_unresolved_vocabulary: has candidate; another term remains unresolved
bucket_rules.candidate_with_open_scope: has candidate; 相关/等/方向 style open scope
bucket_rules.candidate_with_namespace_ambiguity: has candidate; multiple catalog nodes for one name
bucket_rules.candidate_provisional_agency_scope_rule: covered only by the 门类 rule on a non-MOE position; exact characters recorded, agency scope unverified
bucket_rules.candidate_legacy_reason_superseded: has candidate; the legacy review reason no longer reproduces

review_status.semantics: A bucket is a work state, not an eligibility verdict. "legacy_reason_superseded" means the tool no longer reproduces its own old warning, not that the position is cleared.
